name: NNF Multi-Timeframe — Literal PDF
description: One alert-only multi-timeframe strategy from nnf.pdf. Both 4h/1h/15m and 15m/5m/3m groups must agree in the same direction; all conditions are mandatory. The final execution/confirmation candle is 3m. Higher inputs use completed candles only. Shared 3m OBV/EMA9 crossover and 5m price/VWAP filters are counted once. Remember the established trend through pullbacks; require two opposite closes for counter-trend activation. Bearish rules mirror bullish. IMPORTANT: the user retained Stochastic lookback 14, K smoothing 3, D smoothing 1. K equals D, so directional crossover activation cannot occur. RSI SMA9 is a display smoothing line. No orders, positions or invented stop/target calculations.
